description.value:
An orb is a golden sphere, crusted in gems and with a holy symbol atop it. It represents the world, with your deity reigning above it. A sovereign who wields an orb shows that their rulership is divinely ordained.

Edicts Those of your deity.

Anathema Those of your deity; allow a creature to besmirch the name of your deity.

Regalia's Gift You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.hT4INKGtly4QY8KN] cleric feat, using a domain of your deity. You can only cast domain spells while wielding the orb. While wielding the orb, you count as a divine spellcaster for the purposes of wands, staves or other magic items that cast divine spells. At 8th level, you gain access to the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.uR44wELN9OlU68cL] cleric feat and can take it as a class feat. You use your class DC as your spell DC for domain spells.

Setup: create a Focus spellcasting entry (divine, Charisma) for your domain spells; its DC should match your class DC.
